object.attr: analysis: MELLON-CHECK-SRS-17 to -21 say what fits each kind. The GUI's editors can't produce a misfit, but set_attribute, update_object and bulk_set_attribute take any text. Test it with an oracle written apart from the validator (failure analysis, common causes; review Q28).
object.description: If an edit sets an integer, real, boolean or date attribute to a value that validation reports as not fitting the attribute's kind, Mellon shall refuse the edit.
